note: Questions the page test asks the guide and one agent; chapter-specific, so the test can check that the guide hands over to the right agent. The question names a term (shallow copy) that only the Copying subject's concepts (Copying, Shallow copy, Deep copy) define. The agent has executed examples (ShallowCopy, DeepCopy), so a follow-up asking for an example can be answered, and it is not the largest agent (Adding and replacing, with five concepts, is), which the test uses for its earlier questions.
